# noderings_subscription (Data Source)

The active subscription that bills a virtual machine: its price, billing period and renewal date.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_subscription" "web" {
  virtual_machine_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "next_renewal" {
  value = data.noderings_subscription.web.current_period_end
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `virtual_machine_id` (String) ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `billing_period` (String) Billing period, for example `month` or `hour`.
- `billing_type` (String) `subscription` (fixed price), `usage` (billed hourly from credit) or `free`.
- `cancel_at_period_end` (Boolean) Whether the subscription ends instead of renewing at `current_period_end`.
- `currency` (String) Currency of `recurring_amount`, for example `USD`.
- `current_period_end` (String) End of the current billing period (RFC 3339): the next renewal.
- `current_period_start` (String) Start of the current billing period (RFC 3339).
- `has_usage_charges` (Boolean) Whether usage, such as bandwidth overage, is billed on top.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the virtual machine.
- `id` (String) Subscription ID.
- `plan_code` (String) Plan code.
- `plan_id` (String) ID of the plan.
- `plan_name` (String) Plan name.
- `recurring_amount` (Number) Price per billing period.
- `started_at` (String) Start time (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String) `trialing`, `active`, `past_due`, `canceled` or `paused`.
